panels.title: CMTC operations · observed intent and inventory
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**Observe mode:** namespace selection, existing enrollment labels, node inventory and controller activity are live. **Enforcement verification is unavailable.** These readings do not establish workload protection.

Use the cluster selector for one cluster or both. Blue identifies cmtc-a; red identifies cmtc-b in charts and table cells. Workload mTLS, authorization, trust and transport evidence is on the linked **CMTC | Workload Security** page.

panels.title: Controllers reporting
panels.description: Latest controller metric series at range end, one per reporting controller. Not application or datapath readiness.

panels.title: Node inventories ready
panels.description: Latest successful local inventory observations at range end. Not encrypted or protected node counts.

panels.title: Namespaces selected · intent
panels.description: Latest namespace selection intent at range end. The Observe controller does not change labels or enforce traffic.

panels.title: Enforcement verification
panels.description: Native CMTC capability gauge at range end. Zero means verification is unavailable in Observe mode; missing telemetry remains unavailable.

panels.title: Enrollment labels observed
panels.description: Latest namespaces carrying the Cilium enrollment label from any actor. Label presence is intent, not protection.

panels.title: Non-platform namespaces observed
panels.description: Latest non-platform namespace inventory, including explicitly excluded namespaces; not a count of safe-to-enroll namespaces.

panels.title: Namespace decisions · latest share
panels.description: Latest namespace decisions at the selected range end. Selected, excluded, platform and unselected are disjoint and sum to all observed namespaces in the selected clusters. This is inventory/intent, not mTLS coverage. Missing telemetry stays unavailable.

panels.title: Namespace decisions by cluster
panels.description: Latest namespace decision gauges at range end, one row per cluster and decision. Zero is an observed empty category; a missing controller is not zero.

panels.title: Read the namespace categories
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**Selected** = policy intent. **Excluded** = explicit exclusion. **Platform** = protected infrastructure. **Unselected** = remaining namespaces.

The pie includes platform namespaces in its denominator. Non-platform inventory includes excluded namespaces. Enrollment labels are observed from any actor. None of these counts proves mTLS or Protected status.

panels.title: Do controllers and node agents keep up?
Inventory/controller targets reachable
panels.description: Latest successful scrapes at range end. The two-cluster lab expects six inventory/controller targets: two controllers plus four node agents. Opt-in fence targets are shown separately below. Filtered views have fewer targets. Read the target table for individual failures; this count is not an all-healthy verdict.

panels.title: Controller reconcile errors · selected range
panels.description: Controller-runtime reconcile errors counted over the whole selected time range, per cluster. Prometheus extrapolates the increase, so a value can be fractional. An observed zero means no recorded errors in the range; a missing controller is unavailable, not zero.

panels.title: Policy evaluations/s · by cluster
panels.description: Successful CMTC policy evaluations per second over $__rate_interval. A fall to zero can mean idle work; it is not protection readiness. Missing metrics remain unavailable.

panels.title: Controller reconcile p95 · seconds
panels.description: 95th-percentile controller-runtime reconcile duration from real histogram buckets, over $__rate_interval. It measures controller work, not network or TLS latency. No observations mean the percentile is unavailable.

panels.title: Pod inventory by node
panels.description: Latest node-local pod inventory at range end. pod and host classify network mode. Counts are not protected pods or successful platform probes.

panels.title: Inventory/controller targets · current state
panels.description: Latest Prometheus target reachability at range end, with authoritative scrape cluster/component/node labels. UP does not establish workload or certificate readiness.

panels.title: Inventory and controller telemetry boundaries
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content: Rates use the adaptive scrape/zoom interval; counts use the whole selected range. Lines start at zero, with solid blue cmtc-a and dashed red cmtc-b. Tables show the latest observations at range end. **hostNetwork inventory is not platform safety.** API, DNS, probe health, certificate rotation and layered encryption still require their own verified instrumentation.

panels.title: What is still awaiting security qualification?
Implementation status · documented scope, not live health
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
| Capability domain | Where it is shown | Current evidence boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Namespace intent / node inventory | This page, live | Observe is read-only; labels and inventory are intent, not protection |
| Workload mTLS / native DENY | Workload Security, native ztunnel sections | Native panels fill only when node ztunnel runs in cmtc-a/cmtc-b; it is OFF in the combined profile |
| Persistent admission / authorization | Workload Security and planned panels below | Mandatory capture, restore quarantine, effective policy and challenge-bound ACKs remain open |
| CA trust / issuer / rotation | Workload Security trust section | The public issuer-profile producer is live and opt-in; consumption, rotation and cluster identity isolation remain open |
| ClusterMesh / WireGuard / IPsec | Workload Security transport section | ClusterMesh reachability is tested; cross-cluster workload mTLS and layered transport are unqualified |
| Kubernetes / OpenShift platform safety | Planned panels below | Platform namespace exclusion is implemented; required traffic/probe checks remain separate gates |

**Missing security metrics are unknown.** No invented handshake, protected-pod, trust-ready or transport-success numbers are substituted. Planned panels keep every original domain visible until the owning story delivers its collector and real scrape evidence.

panels.title: Audited datapath quarantine · opt-in lab only
Packet counters and quarantine scope
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**One audited workload veth/hook per selected node.** These panels observe the opt-in deny-only DaemonSet, not whole-node traffic or workload mTLS. Packet retransmissions count; counters are not HTTP request totals. **No mTLS or Protected claim.**

A fresh verified sample permits counters to be exported; stale/unverified samples omit counters and report verification 0. Missing exporter/scrape is unavailable. Exact pinned-map adoption retains counters; a newly installed map resets them. There is no meaningful success-percentage pie from these counters.

panels.title: Audited quarantine · latest by node
panels.description: Explicit deny-only disposable-veth prototype. Packets are not requests, connections or TLS handshakes. Missing telemetry remains unavailable; quarantine verification is not Protected or mTLS. Latest 0/1 sample at range end, filtered to reachable scrapes. Do not sum away individual failed or missing nodes.

targets.expr: min by(cluster,node,direction) (cmtc_datapath_fence_quarantine_verified{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-bpf-fence"} @ end()) and on(cluster,node) (up{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-bpf-fence"} @ end() == 1)

panels.title: Packets rejected by audited quarantine/s
panels.description: Explicit deny-only disposable-veth prototype. Packets are not requests, connections or TLS handshakes. Missing telemetry remains unavailable; quarantine verification is not Protected or mTLS. Rate of actual TCX DROP packets over the adaptive scrape interval; an idle verified hook can report zero.

panels.title: Quarantine rejected packets · selected range
panels.description: Explicit deny-only disposable-veth prototype. Packets are not requests, connections or TLS handshakes. Missing telemetry remains unavailable; quarantine verification is not Protected or mTLS. Prometheus extrapolated selected-range packet increase; retransmits count. This is not an exact application-attempt ledger.

panels.title: skb bytes rejected by quarantine/s
panels.description: Explicit deny-only disposable-veth prototype. Packets are not requests, connections or TLS handshakes. Missing telemetry remains unavailable; quarantine verification is not Protected or mTLS. skb byte lengths per second, including network headers; not payload or encrypted bytes.

panels.title: Fence metrics targets · latest reachability
panels.description: Explicit deny-only disposable-veth prototype. Packets are not requests, connections or TLS handshakes. Missing telemetry remains unavailable; quarantine verification is not Protected or mTLS. UP means only scrape reachable. Missing expected nodes must be checked against the explicit selected-node ledger; this table cannot invent a missing target.

panels.title: Audited packet observation · opt-in lab only
Read observation separately from quarantine
panels.description: Visible context and scope; documented status is not a live health metric.

options.content:
**Observer counts packets at an audited TCX hook before native Cilium makes its verdict.** It returns NEXT and does not allow/deny traffic itself. Native Cilium can still drop a counted packet. These are skb/packet totals, not HTTP attempts, connections or TLS handshakes.

The observer and deny-only fence have different hooks/lifecycles. They are qualified sequentially and cannot be combined into an outcome pie. Missing observer telemetry means it is not installed or not reporting; no successful zero is invented. A fresh idle observer can report zero, and unpinned maps reset on process/attachment restart.

panels.title: Audited observer · latest by node
panels.description: Opt-in Observe prototype at one audited TCX hook per selected node, before native Cilium verdict. The observer returns NEXT, so its counters do not prove forwarding, a Cilium decision, requests, TLS or protection. Latest fresh0/1 sample at range end, filtered to reachable scrapes. Failed/missing expected nodes remain an explicit evidence gate.

targets.expr: min by(cluster,node,direction) (cmtc_datapath_observer_ready{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-bpf-observer"} @ end()) and on(cluster,node) (up{job="cmtc",cluster=~"$cluster",component="cmtc-bpf-observer"} @ end() == 1)

panels.title: Packets observed before Cilium verdict/s
panels.description: Opt-in Observe prototype at one audited TCX hook per selected node, before native Cilium verdict. The observer returns NEXT, so its counters do not prove forwarding, a Cilium decision, requests, TLS or protection. Packet rate over the adaptive scrape interval. Retransmits/non-HTTP traffic count; zero can mean idle. Missing/stale counters remain unavailable.

panels.title: skb bytes observed before Cilium verdict/s
panels.description: Opt-in Observe prototype at one audited TCX hook per selected node, before native Cilium verdict. The observer returns NEXT, so its counters do not prove forwarding, a Cilium decision, requests, TLS or protection. skb byte lengths per second over the adaptive interval, including network headers; not payload or encrypted bytes.

panels.title: Observer metrics targets · latest reachability
panels.description: Opt-in Observe prototype at one audited TCX hook per selected node, before native Cilium verdict. The observer returns NEXT, so its counters do not prove forwarding, a Cilium decision, requests, TLS or protection. Latest scrape UP is reachability only. The two-worker observer qualification expects one selected worker per cluster; this is separate from the four-node fence profile.

panels.title: Can workloads be verified as protected? · planned
Verified cluster gates · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. All required verified cluster gates satisfied for the current generation and freshness window. Mapped status/table; no sum that hides one failed or missing required gate. Owner: CMTC cluster controller. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_cluster_ready

panels.title: Pods protected · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Eligible current pods with fresh verified mandatory capture, identity and destination enforcement. Latest state count/table; no inference from enrollment or ACK. Owner: CMTC enforcement verifier. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_pods_protected

panels.title: Pods awaiting enforcement · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Eligible current pods awaiting one or more required enforcement gates. Latest state count/table; exclusive with protected/failed states. Owner: CMTC enforcement verifier. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_pods_pending

panels.title: Pods enforcement failed · planned
panels.description: Planned instrumentation; missing data means not implemented, never success. Current eligible pods in a failed enforcement state, not cumulative failure events. Latest state count/table; never rate() this gauge. Owner: CMTC enforcement verifier. Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_pods_enforcement_failed

panels.title: Platform dependency health · planned

Proposed labels/source must be qualified in the delivering story. Metric contract: cmtc_platform_dependency_healthy
